name: engram-web-assets
description: Version manifest for the vendored JS in internal/web/static. Not a build system: `npm run assets` copies dist files into static/, which are then embedded into the Go binary via go:embed. Dependabot tracks these deps; after merging a bump PR, run `npm ci && npm run assets` and commit the refreshed files.

scripts.assets: cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js internal/web/static/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js internal/web/static/alpine.min.js
